This error message means that you don't have Merge.Plugin.dll in your plugins folder git clone --recursive -b kiln https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind.git cd nethermind/src/Nethermind dotnet build Nethermind.sln -c Release cd Nethermind.Runner dotnet run -c Release -- --config kiln --JsonRpc.Host=0.0.0.0 --JsonRpc.JwtSecretFile=/tmp/jwtsecret with these steps (don't use no-build) you should have Merge.Plugin in your plugins folder I was still carrying over `--no-build` on all instances from my previous machine. excerpts.author: marekm3498
excerpts.content:
Do you have logs maybe? Please DM me if you have them. We fixed one issue on restarts recently. This error message means that you don't have Merge.Plugin.dll in your plugins folder 

git clone --recursive -b kiln https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind.git
cd nethermind/src/Nethermind
dotnet build Nethermind.sln -c Release
cd Nethermind.Runner
dotnet run -c Release -- --config kiln --JsonRpc.Host=0.0.0.0 --JsonRpc.JwtSecretFile=/tmp/jwtsecret

with these steps (don't use no-build) you should have Merge.Plugin in your plugins folder

excerpts.author: seamonkey82
excerpts.content: I was still carrying over `--no-build` on all instances from my previous machine.  That fixed it.  Thank you!
